entry.summary:

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 1,000Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 12

Summary: A vase of fading silk roses unfurled their petals. The summer sun seared the air. The petrichor scent of warm, drying grave dust mingled with the cloying fake rose scent clinging to the fabric as they both warred, and lost, against the overwhelming smell of freshly cut grass. Puffy clouds lazed about. Derek watched them, watched the trees, watched the way the graveyard looked in the sun for the first time since high school. The fake flower scent drew his eyes back to last week's rose, left in the dead of night, still clinging to its colors beneath the inevitable bleaching light of the sun.In which acknowledges the darkness of his past and recalls the events of 'Gas Station Roses' before embracing the present and moving towards the happiness of his future.

Summary: Stiles is living in New York in a crappy apartment with no friends, a shitty job, roommates that spend all their time yelling at each other and following it up with the loudest sex imaginable. He isn't happy. In fact, he's quite depressed, but he won't admit that when his dad checks in. Except one night he receives a call that his father has died in a house fire.On his return, he discovers that his father never stopped investigating the Hale fire from years ago, and he believes that whoever set that fire also killed his dad for learning too much. Now, he has a mission. Find who set the fires, and hopefully the surviving Hale family who might be able to give him answers. (And maybe there's a closed-off alpha werewolf who could also use some comfort.)
